checks.description: Identify the documents DNCC lists for a new trade-licence application.
checks.answerable_scope: The DNCC procedure lists an owner's photograph and photocopy of national identity card, no-objection certificate, proof of capital, memorandum and articles of association, ownership evidence (deed or porcha), updated holding-tax payment proof, and other identification or clearance documents where required. It also lists a fire-service licence photocopy for industrial factories.

checks.description: Identify which listed application documents are conditional on tenancy or business type.
checks.answerable_scope: The procedure specifies a rent agreement for applicants who are tenants and a fire-service licence photocopy for industrial factories; other identification or clearance documents are required where applicable.
